title: Four Home
text: The scouts sit by your Command Core with their backs to it, wrapped in thermal sheets, saying very little. One of them asks whether it's true that Marrow is still captain. When you say yes, she laughs until she cries.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The lander lifts. The scouts watch Pip go and don't look back.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay a while. The scouts would rather we didn't.
